item.title: Suburbia, USA
item.dc:creator: Alex Ding
item.description:
Hello again, and again the humid heat sticks to my skin like the sap of square-cut rosemary bushes too scared to exhale their scent smile and nod.

How could four months do this to me? a shadow among the fuzzy pinks and teals empty, black I walk too fast, talk too little don't want a drink, don't want to go bowling Good afternoon, how are you doing?

the only thing that lives here are the ducks frantically paddling beneath the surface I think anything bigger gets shot What am I looking at? Oh, just the hawk with the pigeon in it's claws The one you just startled Guess you didn't notice

The birds sing regulation songs for storybook families in cages of regulation stucco walls they scream in their sleep we were like that once Happy new year to you too. is anything new?
